workarounds.note: every white square of the crossword gets its second line from a word joiner (U+2060): 1.4.1 drops a table-cell paragraph that is empty or holds only a no-break space, and with U+00A0 there every row came out one line deep (5.1 mm), a grid 45.5 mm tall instead of 84.7 mm square
the level-1 heading sets span: 'page' in this single-column booklet: kept in the column, the opener is clipped at the 16 mm top margin, which cuts the top of the colour field and the kicker
bodyText.boldColor is restated in ink for the bold clue numbers in the clue box: without it the box's bold takes the default #295AA3, since the palette does not reach callout bold in 1.4.1
col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId: a heading style's palette follows the id, but the document palette never reaches design elements in 1.4.1
the word-bank chips are ink on paper and coral, colours no puzzle's palette overrides: a chip linked to 'band' would keep the base sea blue on the word-search page
the H1 page break is restated in headings.levels[0].breakBefore, since any headings object drops the default one
design text lineHeight is given as a multiple (1 and 0.95), never as a dimension
